name: CUMYL-PICA
summary: CUMYL-PICA (SGT-56) is an indole-3-carboxamide based synthetic cannabinoid. It is the α,α-dimethylbenzyl analogue of SDB-006.

pharmacology.text: CUMYL-PICA acts as an agonist for the cannabinoid receptors, with Ki values of 59.21 nM at CB1 and 136.38 nM at CB2 and EC50 values of 11.98 nM at CB1 and 16.2 nM at CB2.

uses.text: It was briefly sold in New Zealand during 2013 as an ingredient of at the time legal synthetic cannabis products, but the product containing CUMYL-BICA and CUMYL-PICA was denied an interim licensing approval under the Psychoactive Substances regulatory scheme, due to reports of adverse events in consumers.

summaryZh: SGT-56（也稱為CUMYL-PICA）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C23H28N2O，帶有吲哚-3-甲醯胺結構，與其同系物SDB-006都為人工合成的大麻素。
summaryZhHans: SGT-56（也称为CUMYL-PICA）是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C23H28N2O，带有吲哚-3-甲酰胺结构，与其同系物SDB-006都为人工合成的大麻素。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it from controlled studies in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, anxiety, paranoia, vomiting, psychosis, seizures and kidney injury, and their effects are often stronger and less predictable than cannabis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前缺乏人體對照研究的資料。同類的合成大麻素可能造成心跳過快、焦慮、妄想、嘔吐、精神病症狀、癲癇發作與腎臟損傷，作用往往比大麻更強、更難預測。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前缺乏人体对照研究的数据。同类的合成大麻素可能造成心跳过快、焦虑、妄想、呕吐、精神病症状、癫痫发作与肾脏损伤，作用往往比大麻更强、更难预测。

fact.en: In 2013 it was sold in New Zealand under a world-first system meant to license new recreational drugs, but the product containing it was refused approval after reports of harmful effects.
fact.zh: 2013 年，它在紐西蘭以一套全球首創、用於核發新型娛樂性藥物許可的制度販售，但含有它的產品在出現不良反應報告後被拒絕核准。
fact.zhHans: 2013 年，它在新西兰以一套全球首创、用于核发新型娱乐性药物许可的制度贩售，但含有它的产品在出现不良反应报告后被拒绝核准。
